fields.description: Planned budget amount for the period, as manually entered by the user in the linked Google Sheet. Mapped from a user-declared column (e.g. 'Budget', 'Budget plan') via the datastream column_mapping. Additive over rows. Currency is user-defined (no currency code stored at field level). NULL when the cell is empty or non-numeric (AD-9: never silently coerced to 0).

ISO-8601 date string identifying the period of the objective row. Parsed from the user-declared date_column in the datastream column_mapping (e.g. 'Date', 'Periode'). Rows with an empty or sentinel date value (-, N/A, null, #N/A) are skipped at parse time and never ingested (AD-9). Used as the primary time grain for joining with realised metrics.

Row identifier used to distinguish multiple objective rows on the same date (e.g. one row per marketing channel or campaign). Parsed from the optional row_id_column in the datastream column_mapping (e.g. 'Canal', 'Campagne'). When row_id_column is absent, defaults to the synthetic value 'row_N' where N is the 1-based row index in the sheet. Forms the composite grain (date, sheet_row_id) together with project_id.

Conversion count objective for the period, as manually entered by the user in the linked Google Sheet. Mapped from a user-declared column (e.g. 'Objectif Conversions', 'Target Conversions') via the datastream column_mapping. Integer count; additive over rows. This is a forward-looking objective, not a realised conversion count. NULL when cell is empty or non-numeric.

Revenue objective for the period, as manually entered by the user in the linked Google Sheet. Mapped from a user-declared column (e.g. 'Objectif CA', 'Target Revenue') via the datastream column_mapping. Additive over rows. This is a forward-looking objective, not a realised revenue figure; it does not participate in cross_source_conversions deduplication. NULL when cell is empty or non-numeric.
